question.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 5 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 4 \\ -4\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$
question.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 5 \\ 2\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 4 \\ -4\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ 0 \\ 3{x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-{x}_{2} \\ 5{x}_{2} \\ 2{x}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ {x}_{3} \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 4 \\ -4\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} \\ 5{x}_{2}+{x}_{3} \\ 3{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 4 \\ -4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}=-3 \\ 5{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=4 \\ 3{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}=-4\end{aligned}
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 5 & 1 & 4 \\ 3 & 2 & 0 & -4\end{aligned}]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 5 & 1 & 4 \\ 3 & 2 & 0 & -4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 5 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 5 & 0 & 5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-1){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 5 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{5}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & 0.2 & 0.8 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :=-{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & 0.2 & 0.8 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}=-3 \\ {x}_{2}+\,0.2{x}_{3}=0.8 \\ {x}_{3}=-1.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get ${x}_{3}=-1.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get 

$$
{x}_{2}+0.2(-1)=0.8\,⟹\,{x}_{2}=1.
$$

   

Finally,  substituting ${x}_{2}=1$ into the first equation, we obtain

$$
{x}_{1}-(1)=-3\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=-2.
$$

So, the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=-2$, ${x}_{2}=1$, and ${x}_{3}=-1,$ which means  

$$
-2{a}_{1}+{a}_{2}-{a}_{3}=b.
$$

Consequently, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=-2+1-1=-2.
$$
